Multiple Teeth Solutions

Replace Multiple Missing Teeth

All-on-4 From £12,995 · Bridges From £2,950

Lost several teeth or need a full arch replaced? From implant bridges for 2-3 teeth to All-on-4 full mouth reconstruction - we have solutions for every situation.

Free 15-Min Chat1-Hour Consultation — £80Call 020 71833573

✓ Same-Day Teeth Possible · ✓ 0% Finance* · ✓ Fixed Teeth in One Day

When you've lost multiple teeth, the right solution depends on how many teeth are missing and where they're located in your mouth.

Multiple missing teeth create a cascade of problems: remaining teeth shift and tilt, your bite becomes misaligned, bone loss accelerates, and facial structure changes. The good news? Modern implant dentistry offers long-lasting solutions that restore both function and aesthetics - often in a single day.

At Dental Implants London, we focus on implant bridges for replacing 2-4 adjacent teeth, and All-on-4 full arch implants for patients who have lost most or all teeth in one arch. Both solutions provide fixed, long-lasting teeth that look and function like natural ones.

All-on-4: Full Arch Replacement

The All-on-4 technique is revolutionary for patients missing most or all teeth. Using just 4 strategically placed implants, we can support a full arch of fixed teeth - often delivering your new smile the same day as surgery.

How All-on-4 Works

  • • Two implants placed vertically at the front
  • • Two implants angled at 45° at the back
  • • Maximizes bone contact without grafting
  • • Provisional teeth fitted same day
  • • Final zirconia bridge after 3-4 months

Ideal Candidates

  • • Missing all or most teeth in one arch
  • • Struggling with loose dentures
  • • Multiple failing teeth needing extraction
  • • Patients with some bone loss
  • • Want a fixed, non-removable solution

Implant Bridges: For 2-4 Adjacent Teeth

If you're missing 2, 3, or 4 teeth in a row, an implant-supported bridge is often the best solution. Unlike traditional bridges that damage healthy adjacent teeth, implant bridges are anchored to implants - preserving your natural teeth.

An implant bridge typically uses 2 implants to support 3-4 replacement teeth. This is more cost-effective than individual implants for each missing tooth, while still providing excellent stability and natural appearance.

Why Choose London Over Treatment Abroad?

In recent years, "Dental Tourism" has become popular, promising cheap makeovers in countries like Turkey or Hungary. While the initial price tag looks appealing, the hidden costs and long-term risks can be devastating. At our South Kensington clinic, we often treat patients requiring complex corrective work after failed treatments abroad.

Risks of Going Abroad

  • • Aggressive Preparation: Often, healthy teeth are filed down aggressively to fit crowns quickly.
  • • Lack of Aftercare: If an infection occurs or a screw loosens, your dentist is thousands of miles away.
  • • Unknown Materials: Traceability of implant brands used abroad is often poor, making repairs in the UK difficult.
  • • Communication Barriers: Subtleties in your aesthetic preferences may be lost in translation.

The London Advantage

  • • CQC Regulated: We are regulated by the Care Quality Commission, ensuring strict safety and hygiene standards.
  • • GDC Registered Dentists: Our surgeons are accountable to the UK General Dental Council.
  • • Ongoing Care: We are here for your regular maintenance, hygiene, and any adjustments needed.
  • • Premium Materials: We use top-tier Titanium and Zirconia with full warranty documentation.

Luxury Care at Competitive Prices

Many patients assume that London private dentistry is out of reach. We have challenged this by optimizing our efficiency without compromising on quality.

Our single implants start from £2,950 (including the crown). This price point rivals many European clinics when you factor in flights, hotels, and the risk of return visits for repairs. We offer transparent pricing with no hidden fees, and 0% finance options are available to spread the cost (subject to status).

Regulated Excellence

We are fully registered with the Care Quality Commission (CQC), the independent regulator of health and social care in England. This means our clinic is regularly inspected to ensure we meet fundamental standards of quality and safety.

When you choose us, you are choosing a sterile, safe, and professional environment where your health is the absolute priority. Choosing a regulated provider ensures accountability, clear safety standards, and appropriate follow-up care.
